Town Clerk
The Town Clerk is an appointed position. The term is three years.
Many of the duties of the Town Clerk are governed by Federal, State and Local By-Laws. The following is a list of some of the duties carried out by the Town Clerk: Chief Registrar of Voters, Chief Election Official, Recording Officer, Registrar of Vital Records, Public Records Official, Supervisor of Voter Registration, and Licensing Officer.
The Town Clerk:
Prepares local election ballots, oversees the polling place and all elections and election related activities.
Records and certifies all actions of the Town Meeting, submits any By-Law or Zoning By-Law amendments to the Attorney General's Office.
Posts all hearing and meeting notices.
Records and administers Oath of Office, and records all Appointments and Resignations of all Town officials.
Issues Fuel Storage Licenses, Raffle/Bazaar Permits, Dog Licenses, Certified requests for Public Records, Business Certificates " D/B/A", Marriage Licenses.
Conducts the Annual Municipal Census, commonly known as the "Street List" every January
Assists the public with genealogical research.
FAQs
What do I need in order to get a Marriage License?
Contact the
Northfield Town Clerk’s Office by email
[email protected]
or phone(413) 498-2901 ext 112
to schedule an appointment to complete your
Marriage Intentions
.
Both parties must appear in person and provide a
photo ID
showing that they are
at least 18 years old
.
After completing the Marriage Intentions, there is a
3-day waiting period
before you can return to the Town Clerk’s Office to pick up your marriage license.
Please note:
The Town Clerk’s Office is
closed on Fridays
.
Once issued, the marriage license is valid for
60 days
.
The marriage license may be used
anywhere in the Commonwealth of Massachusetts
.
You
do not need to be a Northfield resident
to apply for a marriage license in Northfield.
The fee is
$15 for Northfield residents
and
$18 for non-residents
.
Payment is accepted by
cash or check
.
After the Wedding
After the marriage ceremony, the completed marriage license must be
returned to the Northfield Town Clerk’s Office
so the marriage can be recorded.
Certified copies of the Marriage Certificate
may be purchased from the Town Clerk’s Office for
$5 each
.
The Marriage Certificate will always be with the Town Clerk's office where the couple
fill out
their Notice of Intention of Marriage, not the town where the wedding was.
What are some of the responsiblities of the Town Clerk?
The Town Clerk is responsible for Vital Records, Birth, Marriage, and Death. The Town Clerk also over sees all Special and annual town meetings and elections.
Is it on file in Northfield?
The death certificate is on file in Northfield if the death occurred in Northfield or the deceased resided in Northfield and the death occurred within the state.
